top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Edge Higher, Crude Oil Extends Losses: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and US equity-index futures advanced with traders looking to a US-China summit later this week for signs of progress on trade between the world’s two biggest economies. Oil fell for a fourth day.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Diesel Tops $6.50 a Gallon as Wars Worsen Global Fuels Crunch
top_signals.summary: US retail diesel prices topped $6.50 a gallon for the first time, extending a war-driven rally that’s rippling through the economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
